# gamers4.life fixture

Original file, unmodified. Used only by automated tests (`tests/craftingGraph.test.ts`).

| File | Source | Checked |
|------|--------|---------|
| `crafting-graph.json` | `https://gamers4.life/aion-2/database/crafting-graph.json`, saved by the user in a browser on 2026-10-31 | Valid JSON, 863 KB. 1,466 items (`n` name, icon, grade, categories) and 2,442 recipes: profession `p`, race `qr` (light = Elyos, dark = Asmodian, 1,221 each), mastery `ml`, fee `gold`, inputs `in` as `[item key, quantity, recipe key or null]`, output `out` x `outq`, combo chance `cp` and combo item. Item keys are the game's, identical to aion2.exchange (`610530001` = Refining Stone). |

Not stated by the file: region (names are English and match aion2.exchange Global items), game
version, licence. 952 recipes list no input. 497 names are shared by several item keys (variants).
